headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson's impressive performance included three home runs and six RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers in a close game, securing a 4-3 victory. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 3 RBIs on a single hit in 4 at-bats.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. Washington Nationals right fielder James Wood has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The Athletics have also suffered injuries, with LHP Jeffrey Springs on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 1, 2026, due to right hip discomfort, and 1B Nick Kurtz on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 1, 2026, with a strained right thumb.

The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics on August 3, 2026, in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins made several trades, acquiring RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for RHP Lake Bachar. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.
